reviewer.agent: Claude Code (file handoff; environment names the handoff channel)

themes.label: Regulatory framework so AI serves good
themes.definition: Call for an appropriate regulatory framework to ensure AI and generative AI serve good rather than evil purposes.
themes.inclusion: Include calls for regulatory frameworks for AI to steer it toward beneficial use.
themes.exclusion: Exclude statements about AI being neglected without a regulatory call.
themes.boundary_cases: Support for the Secretary-General's actions alongside regulatory calls is also coded AI_UN_ROLE.

examples.quote: then an appropriate framework for regulatory action must be put in place

themes.label: Support for Secretary-General's AI actions
themes.definition: Endorsement of the UN Secretary-General's actions on AI.
themes.inclusion: Include expressions of support for SG or UN initiatives on AI.
themes.boundary_cases: Implicit reference to SG actions following an AI regulation sentence counts here.

examples.quote: We therefore support the actions of the Secretary- General

themes.label: AI and preserving democracy
themes.definition: Framing AI governance as a test of whether democracy is preserved or allowed to crumble.
themes.inclusion: Include passages linking AI to the survival or erosion of democracy.
themes.exclusion: Exclude election-specific disinformation claims (AI_DISINFORMATION) unless democracy's survival is the frame.
themes.boundary_cases: Rhetorical questions about future judgement on democracy count when tied to AI.

examples.quote: whether we sought to preserve our democracy or whether we allowed it to crumble

themes.label: AI overshadowed by climate crisis
themes.definition: Observation that AI receives insufficient attention because other crises (climate) dominate the agenda.
themes.inclusion: Include statements that AI is not a focal point or is crowded out by other priorities.
themes.exclusion: Exclude lists of crises that merely include AI.
themes.boundary_cases: If the speaker uses neglect to argue for urgent regulation, code both this and AI_GLOBAL_GOVERNANCE.

examples.quote: AI is not in the immediate focal point of many because the drama and the crises that surround climate are taking up all of the oxygen

value.rationale: A single Barbados 2023 passage calls for AI regulation for good purposes, supports the SG, links AI to democracy's survival, and notes AI is neglected relative to climate.
